js.help:
Keyboard shortcuts:
  1-5 = change label (1=Planned 2=In Progress 3=Watching 4=Pending 5=Done; Discard via the bottom button)
  d = +1 day / w = +1 week / m = +1 month / Shift+D = -1 day
  a = select all cards on screen / Esc = close picker + clear selection
  Tab = cycle cards / Ctrl+S = save the edit pane
  Note: the state / due badges are display-only. Use the "Change ▾" / "Due ▾" buttons on each card.
js.save_conflict:
Save failed: another editor changed the same file (mtime conflict).
Re-select the card to reload the latest version.
js.fm_save_conflict:
